detail.longDescription:
Game Emulator is a modern multi system emulator for Apple platforms.
Play classic games across PS1, NES, SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Nintendo 64, Sega Genesis and Nintendo DS.
Import your ROMs and keep your library organized with artwork.
Fast launch and smooth gameplay with a clean, modern interface.
Save states let you stop and resume anytime with quick save and quick load.
Cheats help you customize difficulty and explore games your way.
Play with touch controls, keyboard or external controllers.
Customize play with controller skins.
No ads.
Use only games and BIOS files you are legally entitled to use.

Subscription is optional.
Without subscription you can use all emulator features.
Subscription unlocks unlimited games in your library.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.


Privacy: https://www.agiapplications.org/apps/game-emulator/privacy
Terms: https://www.agiapplications.org/apps/game-emulator/terms
